cover.desc: Mei holds up a melon bun triumphantly while Ren looks baffled behind her, flat pastel anime coloring and soft morning light.

panels.bg: quiet Japanese high school hallway before class, shoe lockers, morning light
panels.action: A wrapped melon bun rests alone on a windowsill.

dialogue.text: Before first period, a mystery appeared.

chars.name: mei
chars.pose: leaning toward the windowsill with hands behind her back

panels.bg: school hallway window, soft sparkle screentone
panels.action: Mei studies the abandoned bun like a detective examining evidence.

dialogue.text: Did you wait here for me?

chars.name: ren
chars.pose: running into frame and reaching forward

chars.name: mei
chars.pose: freezing with one hand above the bun

panels.bg: school hallway with dramatic speed lines
panels.action: Ren lunges into the hallway just as Mei reaches for the bun.
Tiny chibi Mei pretends she was never interested in the bun.

chars.name: ren
chars.pose: unwrapping the melon bun and breaking it neatly in half

panels.bg: sunlit classroom by the window, gentle flower screentone
panels.action: Ren divides the bun and offers half to Mei.

chars.name: mei
chars.pose: accepting the bun with both hands

panels.action: Mei accepts the offered half with unexpected sincerity.

chars.name: ren
chars.pose: sitting at the next desk with tense shoulders

panels.bg: classroom desks, classmates arriving in the distance
panels.action: They eat in companionable silence as the classroom begins to fill.

chars.name: mei
chars.pose: raising one index finger beside her lips

panels.bg: black halftone gradient with a single sparkle
panels.action: Mei reveals she has already planned the next morning's encounter.

dialogue.text: Meet me here before the bell.
